acceptance_criteria: The operator selects one same-repository GitHub-rooted Build Order without mixed membership
GitHub ticket facts and native blockers remain authoritative while Aiur activity stays a separate live overlay
Catalog and selected graphs remain truthful through partial failure invalid roots cycles external blockers and restart
The authenticated read-only graph is keyboard touch pointer and screen-reader usable through 100 members
Reusable all-state context preserves capability-gated Aiur actions without enabling GitHub planning mutation
required_documentation: Build Order metadata and GitHub relationship authoring guide
Provider health freshness and troubleshooting guide
Operator route graph interaction and accessibility guide
required_cleanup: Remove duplicate AgentList activity ownership after migration
Remove temporary acceptance fixtures and compatibility code explicitly owned by this feature
end_to_end_proof: Published native GitHub root exercised through the real Aiur CLI TUI and authenticated browser
Synthetic cycle invalid degraded and 20 50 100-member browser evidence
Post-merge current-main smoke preserving Units Commands Analytics and TUI
feature_boundary.completion_condition: BO-001 through BO-015 are implemented and reviewed, green on the current configured integration branch, merged, documented, cleaned up, and proven after merge; standalone companions and deferred work cannot extend completion.

decisions.summary: Split GitHub planning truth from Aiur runtime activity
decisions.rationale: Each system owns different facts and neither may overwrite the other.

decisions.summary: Use labeled root issues and direct native sub-issues
decisions.rationale: Stable selectable membership avoids per-feature labels and a second planning database.

decisions.summary: Use native blockedBy as the only hard dependency truth
decisions.rationale: Native relationships and completed-only satisfaction prevent prose and progress drift.

decisions.summary: Keep phase lane and complexity metadata strict and single-valued
decisions.rationale: Ambiguity remains visible as a warning rather than a silently selected value.

decisions.summary: Publish only complete atomic last-known-good graph generations
decisions.rationale: Partial provider responses must never make dependencies disappear.

decisions.summary: Move shared activity ownership out of AgentList
decisions.rationale: Headless and interactive consumers need one typed daemon-owned projection.

decisions.summary: Use accessible DOM cards with a vendored layout-only worker
decisions.rationale: A maintained engine computes geometry while Aiur retains semantics rendering and product state.

decisions.summary: Keep GitHub planning read-only in v1
decisions.rationale: GitHub remains authoritative; existing Aiur actions retain independent security contracts.

decisions.summary: Keep dashboard catch-up and accounting outside Build Order
decisions.rationale: Standalone presentation and financial work cannot alter the bounded feature terminal condition.

decisions.summary: Treat phase as presentation and rollout guidance only
decisions.rationale: Readiness comes from dependencies outcomes health conflicts and capacity.
Planning publishes truth and routing metadata but leaves activation to the later Executor.

decisions.summary: Protect the finite feature boundary during execution
decisions.rationale: Contained rework and deferred findings prevent legitimate discoveries from creating an endless run.

requirements.summary: Select one repository-qualified GitHub-rooted Build Order without mixing roots
Use direct native membership and strict renderable planning metadata
Use native blockers and five-state conservative readiness
Publish only complete bounded provider generations with separate catalog and selected health
Carry trusted repository-qualified identity through ticket events
Expose one daemon-owned activity projection and migrate AgentList
Join planning and runtime snapshots without I/O or guessed defaults
Establish deterministic real-browser accessibility and performance infrastructure
Ship a pinned local layout-only worker platform
Integrate generation-safe semantic DOM and SVG layout with fallback
Provide reusable cached all-state ticket context
Provide URL-backed selection and explicit graph/provider states
Support equivalent keyboard pointer touch focus and relationship interaction
Prove responsive accessible behavior and bounded 100-member scale
Own merged current-base documentation cleanup and end-to-end acceptance
